cases.short: Take only the first round of the narrow replay.
cases.narrow: Complete the original narrow replay and stop.
cases.expanding: Run the original narrow prefix then the full-trace phase.

hintPolicy.final: Stay packed while windows remain in the named scope. If a query expands it, continue with the whole-index budget and the live caches.
hintPolicy.expand: Load the regional pricing table and use the earlier regional purchase budget.

criterion: Pair both hints with all three actual endings. Charge the compact UTF-8 hint payload once and charge regional pricing only when used. Test that false hints affect costs while preserving all answers. Contrast fixed representations, unconditional hint policies and a whole-index policy without a hint. Derive a conditional break-even expansion probability from measured costs and give no population reliability estimate.
